Test cases:

- builder() returns non-null Builder.
- getInstance() returns factory and default meta schema URI not null.

Then in getInstance(versionFlag) they call JsonSchemaVersion jsonSchemaVersion = checkVersion(versionFlag); JsonMetaSchema metaSchema = jsonSchemaVersion.getInstance(); If versionFlag null, jsonSchemaVersion null => NPE. So test expecting NullPointerException.

- checkVersion with each enum value returns appropriate class (instance of Version...); test unsupported value: maybe a fake enum? Not possible. So test null returns null.

- builder(blueprint) returns builder with same config; we can create factory via getInstance(V4), then builder = JsonSchemaFactory.builder(factory); assert not null.

- getUriFactory returns non-null.

- getUriTranslator returns non-null.

- getSchema(String) with valid JSON returns JsonSchema (we may just assert not null). Need to import JsonSchema class; we can check that no exception.

- getSchema(String) with malformed JSON should throw JsonSchemaException. Provide invalid JSON string.

- getSchema(InputStream) same.

- getSchema(URI) with a local resource: we need to mock fetching? The default factory uses URLFetcher that accesses real URLs; we can use a file URI referencing a temporary file with simple schema JSON. Use temporary file with .json extension and content {"type":"object"}.

- Edge case: getSchema(URI) with unsupported scheme causing URIFactory create exception? Maybe use URI with unknown scheme e.g., "invalid://test". Expect JsonSchemaException.

- getSchema(URI) with null config? Already covered.

- getSchema(URI, JsonNode, Config) just passes through; we can test with null JsonNode? Implementation just calls newJsonSchema which expects schemaNode; but passing null will cause NullPointerException later? Actually newJsonSchema expects JsonNode schemaNode, then createValidationContext uses schemaNode; findMetaSchemaForSchema will call schemaNode.get("$schema") leading NPE. So test expecting NullPointerException.

- idMatchesSourceUri private; can't test directly.

- isYaml private; can't test.

- normalizeMetaSchemaUri static protected; can test via reflection or subclass; but we can test using reflection to invoke; but not required as public.

Testing getSchema(URI) with caching: call twice and ensure same instance from cache? Could test that second call returns same object reference when caching enabled.
